description: Active simple product on the store with a price above zero (optionally below maxPrice, in or not in a given category) and enough inventory to add to cart. KB: Product Types. Variant children of configurable products are excluded.

quantityUsed.description: Quantity the test adds to cart

maxPrice.description: Optional upper bound (exclusive) on the unit price, e.g. so a cart stays under a promotion's minimum order; left out = any price above zero

inCategoryId.description: Optional: the product must be in this category (e.g. @product.categoryId: same category as another need). Same id kind as promotion_categories.categoryId

notInCategoryId.description: Optional: the product must be in NO category with this id (e.g. @product.categoryId), so a category discount stays off it. Same id kind as promotion_categories.categoryId

minMaxQuantity.description: Optional: the product must allow at least this quantity in the cart (MaximumQuantity >= value); left out = any maximum

notDiscountedForProfile.description: Optional: profile name the test shops as (e.g. Anonymous); no active automatic product/category promotion of the store for that profile (or all profiles) may discount the product

outOfStockOption.description: Optional: stored out-of-stock option the product must have (ZnodePimProduct.OutOfStockOptions), e.g. DisablePurchasing when the test reads the tracked stock quantity; left out = any option

maxPersonalizableAttributes.description: Optional: at most this many personalizable attributes on the product; 0 for flows that reject personalization (Quick Order); left out = any

withBrand.description: Pass true when the test asserts the product's brand (it must have one). Left out: any

withShippingInfo.description: Pass true when the test asserts the product's shipping information (it must have one). Left out: any
